verdict: MedKayfab Pneumology is the RIPE squad's finest hour — 52 cards covering physiology, pharmacology, pathology and clinical reasoning with zero filler. The four classic COPD archetypes, the TB drug quartet (Rifampin Rick through Ethambutol Ed), and Tension Pete are standout G1 cards that play themselves at the table. The Quest pages add a clinical reasoning layer that turns the deck into an active diagnostic game. Weakness: the pneumoconiosis cluster (Cards 23-27) leans descriptive, and a few atypical pneumonia cards need a Gram stain primer to fully deploy. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: Your full lung syllabus as a card game — from alveolar physics to TB antibiotics, 52 persona cards that make pulmonology stick. Perfect for medical students and USMLE grinders who learn by doing, not by highlighting.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: PNEUMOLOGY – Master the Lung From Alveolar Physics to TB Drugs (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

52 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master gas exchange and hypoxemia, the obstructive airway diseases, and the RIPE anti-TB quartet.

Every lung problem is a fight over one thin sheet of tissue, the place where air and blood are supposed to meet and trade. Pneumology is the full catalogue of everything that wedges itself into that handshake: fluid, mucus, pus, pressure, scar, or a drug that was meant to help. Learn it the usual way and you end up with four disconnected piles, obstructive on one list, restrictive on another, the gas-exchange physics on a third, the antibiotics on a fourth. Then a real saturation number starts falling on the ward and none of the piles tell you which one you are looking at.

MedKayfab Pneumology stages the whole respiratory tract as a wrestling card. Every obstruction, infection, and drug becomes a fighter with a tell, so a dropping oxygen reading stops being a riddle and turns into a name you already recognize across the room.

YOU'LL GET
- 52 illustrated MedKayfab cards (13pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Tension Pete, Asthma Ash, and Obstruction Otis
- A bonus Hypoxemia diagnostic flowchart that lays the A-a gradient tree out on a single page
- Free lifetime updates as guidelines evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
You will meet Tension Pete, the pressure that keeps climbing inside the chest until the lung folds and the whole heart gets shoved off its mark. Asthma Ash works the reversible angle: airways that clamp shut the instant they meet their trigger and swing open again the moment you name it. Obstruction Otis is the slow grind of chronic disease, air that walks in without complaint and then refuses to leave. The anti-TB pharmacology runs as its own tag team, the RIPE quartet, with Rifampin Rick turning every body fluid orange and Ethambutol Ed forever checking your eyes before the next dose.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor: the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (targets and doses), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge). The Mechanism Flash mode is the engine of it: explain the pathophysiology or the drug in one sentence without looking, or the patient on the Stage stops breathing and the round ends badly for both of you.

Honest cognitive load
This is a core respiratory engine, built for medical students and USMLE grinders who learn by doing rather than highlighting, and for anyone heading into a pulmonology or internal-medicine rotation. It pairs naturally with Cardiology for the full heart-lung axis behind every hypoxemia, with Intensive Care Medicine when the airway problem becomes a ventilator problem, and with Tropical Medicine and Infectious Disease for the longer tuberculosis arc that the RIPE cards open.

ABOUT MEDKAYFAB
MedKayfab is a narrative medical learning card game, 50 decks covering the full medical curriculum. Every card encodes a clinical mechanism as a character with a personality, a story, and a reasoning challenge. Built by a physician. Assembled with AI tools. Manually revised. Honest about its limitations. Free to use, share, and adapt under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

PAY WHAT YOU WANT
This deck is Pay What You Want, including free. If you find it useful, a fair price is 5 euros. If you are a student on a budget, enter 0, no questions asked. If you want to support more decks, anything above fair price is appreciated. Share freely, attribute honestly, never resell.

DISCLAIMER
MedKayfab is a learning companion, not a clinical reference. Content was created by a physician and reviewed to the best of our knowledge, but medicine evolves, guidelines change, and some mechanisms in here will be simplified or wrong. Always verify against current primary sources and clinical guidelines before applying anything to patient care. The Blödsinn! is the vehicle. The science is serious.

Stay fluffy. — Doc FrizzleBob
